items.headline: AI leveraged-loan investors push back for the first time in years: CoreWeave, Proofpoint among 4+ borrowers forced to sweeten terms in one week
items.note: Money managers overwhelmed by AI-debt supply are now demanding higher yields and stronger protections across multiple unrelated borrowers (CoreWeave's loan repriced to 5.5pts over benchmark; Proofpoint added roughly two dozen covenant changes at a ~9.3% yield) — a market-wide repricing of AI credit risk, not an isolated name.

items.headline: CoreWeave's credit-default swaps spike to 855bp, implying ~50% five-year default odds; Nebius/CoreWeave shares slide on the same read-through
items.note: A sharp, concrete widening in CDS pricing on a heavily-levered neocloud is a direct credit-market signal that financing costs for GPU-backed debt are becoming unsustainable, distinct from the equity move itself.

items.headline: BlackRock prices $12.5B bond for Meta's El Paso data center at 7.53% yield on weak ~$17B order book
items.note: One of the highest yields yet on a blue-chip data-center bond, with demand well below the multiple-times oversubscription that's typical for these deals — a concrete sign that data-center debt issuance is getting harder and costlier to clear.

items.headline: Moody's warns 'unprecedented' AI capex is eroding credit quality at Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and CoreWeave
items.note: Analyst warning rather than a rating action, but it's the clearest statement yet from a major rating agency that the shift from asset-light to capex-heavy AI buildouts is a credit-quality risk across hyperscalers and neoclouds alike.
